page.layout: One column of verse, with running head at top and page number at upper left. Catchword "Seruauit" at lower right. Faint show-through of the reverse page in the right margin, not transcribed.

main_text.p: Statim sequuta est: Juraque qui sciunt Tractare Makiri nepotes: Atque Sati Zabulone Scriba. Tunc me juventus Iissachare[?] ferox Producta forti cum procerum manu Protexit, & firmis Baracum Praesidiis animosa juvit. Non sic Rubeni progenies potens Jordanis alto flumine dissita[?] Commune totius periclum Ausa suo est remouere gentis. Sed tunc honesto praetulit ocium Infame bello: territa tunc suis Haesit latebris, & sequuta Consilium sibi turpe cauit. Non praeliantes sustinuit tribus Juvare sacri foederis immemor: Expauit enses, agminisque Barbaricos strepitus professi. Proles Rubeni quî procul hostium Secura mansit? maluit & boum Audire mugitus, canori Quàm litui fremitus minaces? Quî Guilhadites se pariter suo Jordane clausus continuit domi? Curuasque tunc Danus cupita Merce rates oneranit[?] audax Longum per aequor nauita? Quî sua

page.notes: Verse as printed; the lines run continuously without stanza gaps. Doubtful: "Iissachare" (first letters of a proper name), "dissita" (final letters unclear), "oneranit" (may be oneravit). A small stray speck precedes "Merce" and was not transcribed. Long s rendered as plain s; u/v and i/j normalised per the rules.
